boundaries: Explicit selection of eleven CoreS3 scalar-rail results from two batches; not one twelve-case all-green execution.
Old Light and Buzzer failures remain unchanged and excluded. Original Buzzer once automatic shutdown remains OPEN.
Source validation uses each batch source-freeze and retained tool-sources bytes; historical sources need not equal current worktree files.
Raw HTTP, DOM and serial are asynchronous observations; no atomic LCD/DOM snapshot is claimed.
Heart covers raw samples; Thermal rail covers control register and fixture readiness, not a temperature display.
No new host admission, physical-hardware result, external publication or overall UNIT-01 completion is granted.

Complete PNG decoding is not visual composition, legibility or full-page framing acceptance. Twenty ancillary fullPage images exceed Checker.png pixel admission bounds; the Checker was not modified and no image was resized.

supersedes_for_selection_verdict.reason: Prior audit applied Checker.png 16Mi pixel admission limit beyond its implemented ZIP/native and before-evidence screenshot scope. This supplement preserves that rejection, reruns the unchanged Checker in its implemented scope, and separately decodes all committed PNGs.
